summary.zh: 本次更新聚焦动态列表跳转更精准、图片浏览支持多图切换与下载，以及多处体验修复。
summary.en: Sharper deep links from the activity feed, a multi-image viewer with download, and several experience fixes.

items.zh: 动态列表点击直达对应内容：推送进 commit、评论进 Issue/PR、Fork 进源仓库
items.en: Tap an activity entry to jump straight to its commit, issue/PR or forked repo

items.zh: README 图片全屏浏览支持左右滑动切换多图，并可一键下载当前图片
items.en: Full-screen image viewer now swipes between all README images and can download the current one

items.zh: 仓库详情页双击标签页，直达对应的 GitHub 网页（带当前分支和筛选条件）
items.en: Double-tap a repo tab to open its GitHub web page with the current branch and filters

items.zh: 仓库信息卡右上角新增"复制地址"按钮
items.en: New copy-link button on the repo info card

items.zh: 设置目标语言后 README 自动翻译，与显示状态保持一致
items.en: README auto-translates to your chosen language, matching the toggle state

items.zh: 更新日志改为打开弹框前读取仓库内文件，内容与本轮改动严格对应
items.en: Update notes now load from a repo file so they match exactly what changed

items.zh: 从详情页返回后，"我"页与用户页保持离开时的仓库/动态切换
items.en: Returning to a profile keeps the repos/activity section you left it on

items.zh: 版本更新下载支持断点续传，弱网下不再反复从头下载
items.en: In-app update download resumes after interruptions instead of restarting

items.zh: 普通下载对网络波动自动续传重试，失败后重试也只拉取剩余部分
items.en: Downloads auto-resume on network hiccups; retries fetch only the missing tail

items.zh: 修复发现页 Komi 源选"全部"平台时无数据的问题
items.en: Fixed the Komi discover feed showing no data for the All platform chip

items.zh: 主题设置新增"跟随系统夜间模式"：系统切换深色时自动套用内置深色风格
items.en: New follow-system dark mode: the built-in dark style applies while the OS is in night mode
